exposure: Patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy by general obstetrician-gynecologists
Patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy by maternal-fetal medicine specialists
Patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy by gynecologic oncologists
Surgeon specialty for hysterectomy (general obstetrician-gynecologists, maternal-fetal medicine specialists, and gynecologic oncologists)
Specialty of the attending surgeon (general obstetrician-gynecologists, maternal-fetal medicine specialists, and gynecologic oncologists)
cohort: 2240 patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean delivery and concurrent hysterectomy from 2016 to 2020
finding: Patient characteristics and surgical procedures related to cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum differ based on surgeon specialty, with gynecologic oncologists managing more severe cases, but surgical morbidity remains significant regardless of specialty.
